description: Aggregate test-run counts; groupBy outcome | runType | configId | catalogueTestId | phoneNumber; optional timeBucket day/week/month with UTC ISO8601 bucket keys ("2026-05-12" day, "2026-W19" week, "2026-05" month). Use cases: "% pass/fail this week", "which compliance test fails most", "day-by-day pass count last 2 weeks". ALWAYS use this for "how many", "what share" and "which fails most": counting by paging through listTestRuns gives wrong totals. Filters: runType (mission | compliance | param | load; load = the individual calls load tests made, which are never counted as param), outcome, phoneNumber, configId, catalogueTestId, startedAfter/startedBefore. configId matches the runs of one saved test, standard or mission; there is NO configName filter here, so to count the runs of a named test find its id first (listTestConfigs for a standard test, listMissionTestConfigs for a mission test). With groupBy=configId the keys are ids: name one with getTestConfig (most are standard tests), or getMissionTestConfig if that returns 404. A key of "unknown" means runs with no value for that field. Response capped at top 100 groups by count desc; truncated:boolean indicates cap hit. For whole load-test runs and their statistics use listLoadTestRuns or getLoadTestStatus; listLoadTests lists the saved load tests. D-12: groupBy=stepName returns 400 — for step-level breakdowns within a single run use getRunResults; for step-level aggregation across runs see Phase 1.1.

catalogueTestId.description: Pre-filter runs by compliance catalogue test ID before grouping.

configId.description: Pre-filter runs launched from a specific saved config before grouping.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group counts by. `stepName` is rejected (D-12).

outcome.description: Pre-filter runs by outcome before grouping.

phoneNumber.description: Pre-filter runs by destination number (E.164 exact) before grouping.

runType.description: Pre-filter runs by type before grouping. `load` is load-test calls.

startedAfter.description: ISO8601 lower bound for startedAt (inclusive), applied before grouping.

startedBefore.description: ISO8601 upper bound for startedAt (inclusive), applied before grouping.

timeBucket.description: UTC ISO8601 time granularity (Q-5). Omit for flat group counts.

name: aggregateTestRuns

outputSchema.description:
Response for `GET /testing/runs/aggregate`. Contains either flat `groups`
(no timeBucket) or time-bucketed `buckets` (timeBucket provided).
Q-6: Capped at top 100 groups by count desc; `truncated` indicates cap hit.

buckets.description: Time-bucketed groups (present when timeBucket provided). Q-5 UTC ISO8601 keys.

items.description: A single group within an aggregate response.

count.description: Number of runs in this group.

groups.description: Flat groups sorted by count descending (present when no timeBucket).

items.description: A single group within an aggregate response.

count.description: Number of runs in this group.

totalGroups.description: Total distinct group keys before the 100-group cap.

truncated.description: True when more than 100 unique group keys existed (Q-6 cap hit).
